common.name: Hirelix
common.short: Personal AI recruiting partner for independent recruiters and boutique search firms.
common.long: Hirelix is a personal AI recruiting partner for independent recruiters and boutique search firms. Bring your own CVs, job briefs and recruiting notes into a conversation. Ask the agent to compare candidates, research public information when requested, and prepare client recommendation documents. Saved records can be used in later conversations. Recruiters remain responsible for checking evidence and deciding what to share. Public research depends on available sources and does not guarantee contact information or a fixed shortlist size. A 7-day trial includes 200 AI credits, with no credit card required. Paid plans are $49/month or $490/year, plus applicable taxes; the trial does not automatically convert to a paid subscription.

forms.use_cases: Compare candidate CVs against a role brief; research public evidence when requested; prepare client recommendations; reuse saved candidate records and recruiting notes.
